config.label: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator (default 127
config.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only). For a hosted child in its own network namespace only — never bind a laptop's concentrator to the network.

config.label: Absolute path where fetchproxy stores its long-term identity keypair (default ~/
config.description: Absolute path where fetchproxy stores its long-term identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/). For a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they share one identity.
